lines.en: Ross. Yeah. Look.
Joey, do you know we can see you from here?
How could Richard look so much cooler with one of these than me?
Well, for starters, you may want to light it and lose the spatula.
You know what? I think it's cute. You're trying to be more like Richard.
Not like him, per se. Just not unlike him.
Look, it's the artist formerly known as Chandler.
We're just trying something here, you know.
So, Joey, why didn't you grow a mustache?
Oh, we flipped for it. I got the cigar, he got the mustache.
Well, I think if we both grew, we'd look like dork.
Yeah, you really sidestepped that landmine.
Hey, listen, we gotta go. I promised Richard we'd meet up downstairs.
Oh, come on.
You're meeting Richard?
Yeah, we're going to a ranger game.
Yeah, didn't he tell you?
Oh, he told me he was going out with the guys.
I just didn't know that you were the guys.
You hear that?
We're the guys.
We're the guys.
That mustache, doesn't Chandler remind you of Aunt Sylvia?
